hostname.description: The Terraform Enterprise hostname to connect to. Defaults to app.terraform.io.

ssl_skip_verify.description: Whether or not to skip certificate verifications.

token.description:
The token used to authenticate with Terraform Enterprise. We recommend omitting
the token which can be set as credentials in the CLI config file.

manual_confirm.description: If true, a human will have to manually confirm a plan to start the apply. This applies to the creation only. Destroy never requires manual confirmation. This requires a human to carefully watch the execution of this Terraform run and hit the 'confirm' button. Be aware of resource timeouts during the Terraform run.

organization.description: The name of the Terraform Cloud organization that owns the workspace.

retry.description: Whether or not to retry on plan or apply errors.

retry_attempts.description: The number of retry attempts made for any errors during plan or apply. This applies to both creation and destruction.

retry_backoff_max.description: The maximum seconds to wait between retry attempts. Retries are done using an exponential backoff, so this can be used to limit the maximum time between retries.

retry_backoff_min.description: The minimum seconds to wait between retry attempts.

workspace.description: The name of the Terraform Cloud workspace to execute.
